verdict.rationale: Plan v2 cleanly absorbs all 4 important-severity findings from plan-v1 (I-DR-PL-001..004) with concrete, machine-checkable assertions added to the document. The F-003 silent-drop mitigation is now directly enforced via verbatim grep at four redundant surfaces (T4.4a L1, Phase 4 Exit Criteria BLOCKER, Phase 4 blocking-severity threshold, Phase Validator step 1) rather than relying on auditing-subagents cross-derivation. T7.10 authors packager-input-notes.md binding the I-AA-001 deviation to a deliverable that finalize-deliverable-packager (Stage 13) will read, replacing the OI-PLAN-9 visibility risk. No regressions detected: v1 substance preserved unchanged, NFR-8 verification chain (T0.1 -> T2.1 -> T2.6 -> T7.5) intact, D-13 atomic-migration discipline (T3.1 dry-run + T3.2..T3.6 atomic commits + T3.7 clean-run) intact, AC coverage 67/67 with no orphans either direction, phase ordering respects every Blueprint dependency requirement. Recommended-severity I-DR-PL-005 declined with rationale in OI-PLAN-5; I-DR-PL-006 absorbed via T0.3 disambiguation note; I-DR-PL-007 addressed in Estimation Methodology. Zero new important+ defects introduced. Path to PASS met.
